description: Smartwatches in India now offer varying levels of WhatsApp support, from full messaging to limited calling features. The Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 series provides the most complete experience with messaging and call handling, while Apple Watch models support messaging but not full calling. The Pixel Watch 4 offers similar functionality with partial calling support. Garmin Forerunner 570 recently added WhatsApp messaging via Connect IQ. These devices also include premium features like AMOLED displays, advanced health tracking, and long battery life across different price segments.
title: Best Smartwatches with WhatsApp Calling and Messages in India

description: Bhutan has moved 519.7 Bitcoin worth about $36.75 million from its sovereign holdings to multiple wallets, including one linked to QCP Capital. The transfer, identified through on-chain data, has raised speculation about potential selling activity. The move follows a similar transaction earlier this month, highlighting the country’s active approach to managing its crypto reserves.
title: Bhutan Moves 519 Bitcoin to Multiple Wallets, Including QCP Capital Link

description: Astronomers have discovered a rare brown dwarf binary system undergoing mass transfer with an ultra-short orbit. The pair could either merge or gain enough mass to ignite fusion, potentially forming a new star and redefining how “failed stars” evolve.
title: Brown Dwarf Merger Could Create a New Star, Astronomers Discover

description: OpenAI added a new feature to ChatGPT on Tuesday. Dubbed Library, it is a quality-of-life feature that makes it easier for users to reference previously uploaded files. The San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant highlighted that the feature will help quickly reshare files during conversations, eliminating the need to upload them over and over.
title: OpenAI’s New ChatGPT Feature Makes It Easier to Reference Uploaded Files

description: Google is reportedly working on a new artificial intelligence (AI) feature that will let users create a 3D avatar of themselves for faster content generation. As per the report, the feature is currently under development and is not available to users, including those who have signed up for beta testing.
title: Google Is Reportedly Working on Adding 3D Avatars to Gemini

description: Samsung has announced the Exynos 1680 chipset, expected to power the Galaxy A57 5G. Built on a 4nm process, it features a tri-cluster octa-core CPU, Xclipse 550 GPU based on AMD RDNA 3, and an NPU capable of 19.6 TOPS for on-device AI tasks. The chipset supports up to a 200-megapixel camera, 4K video at 60fps, and full-HD+ displays at 144Hz. It also offers LPDDR5X RAM, UFS 4.1 storage, and connectivity options including 5G, Wi-Fi 6E, and Bluetooth 6.1.
title: Samsung Unveils 4nm Exynos 1680 Chipset With 200-Megapixel Camera, 144Hz Display Support

description: A Thane court has ruled that there is no case against CoinDCX co-founders in an impersonation-linked fraud. The court found no evidence connecting them to the alleged scam, which was carried out by individuals posing as the founders. The decision offers relief to the company while highlighting risks of impersonation in the crypto sector.
title: Court Drops Fraud Case Against CoinDCX Founders, Says No Evidence Found

description: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G and Galaxy A37 5G have been launched in India with triple rear camera units and 5,000mAh batteries. They run on One UI 8.5 based on Android 16. Samsung has not officially revealed the chipset of the new A-series smartphones. The Galaxy A57 5G is believed to have an Exynos 1680 chipset under the hood, while the Galaxy A37 5G could run on an Exynos 1480 chip. Both phones have up to 12GB of RAM and up to 256GB of onboard storage.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G, Galaxy A37 5G With Triple Rear Cameras, 5,000mAh Batteries Announced: Price, Specifications

description: Gemini for Google TV is getting a big upgrade. On Tuesday, the Mountain View-based tech giant announced three new artificial intelligence (AI) features to improve the viewing experience of users and to allow them to find more information without having to look it up on their smartphone. The most notable among them is the new live sports scorecards functionality.
title: Gemini for Google TV Upgraded With Live Sports Scorecards and Interactive Educational Visuals

description: The CFTC has launched an Innovation Task Force to develop regulatory frameworks for crypto and AI. The initiative aims to address gaps in oversight while promoting responsible innovation. By working with industry stakeholders, the regulator seeks to balance growth with safeguards. The move builds on earlier efforts to integrate digital assets into mainstream finance.
title: CFTC Launches Innovation Task Force to Regulate Crypto and AI Markets

description: Xiaomi 17T Pro has reportedly been spotted on the NBTC certification website, suggesting that the Chinese tech firm could launch the new handset in select global markets soon. The purported Xiaomi 17T Pro was listed on the certification database with the model number 2602EPTC0G. It also purportedly confirms the Xiaomi 17T moniker. However, the listing does not reveal any other details about the phone. The handset is expected to be launched as part of the Xiaomi 17T lineup, which is also expected to include the standard Xiaomi 17T. However, the tech firm has yet to confirm its launch.
title: Xiaomi 17T Pro Listing on Thailand's NBTC Certification Site Hints at Imminent Global Launch

description: Avatar: Fire and Ash is finally coming out on Prime Video for Rent. This time, the conflicts will escalate in Pandora as the new force intensifies the situation.
title: Avatar: Fire and Ash OTT Release Date Revealed: Know When and Where to Watch it Online

description: Ultrahuman has returned to the US market with the Ring Pro after the Bengaluru-based tech firm received clearance from the country’s Customs and Border Protection department, the company announced on Tuesday. The new smart ring, which was launched in select global markets on February 27, is currently available for pre-order in the country via the Ultrahuman online store. The Ultrahuman Ring Pro is offered in Aster Black, Bionic Gold, Raw Titanium, and Space Silver colour options. The company also ships a sizing kit, allowing users to choose from sizes 5 to 14 according to their fingers.
title: Ultrahuman Ring Pro Returns to US Market After Oura Patent Dispute

description: Eight Sleep, the New York-based sleep technology company, is planning to expand into the artificial intelligence (AI)-powered predictive sleep health space. The move comes after the startup raised $50 million (roughly Rs. 469.7 crore) in a funding round earlier this month. The company has announced that it is now exploring the sleep health space through its new offerings and technologies currently under development.
title: Eight Sleep Bets Big on AI-Powered Predictive Sleep, Backed by $50 Million Funding

description: Razer has introduced its latest esports-focused peripherals, including a new wireless mouse and a soft gaming mouse mat. The Viper V4 Pro brings upgrades in sensor accuracy, latency, and software tuning, along with extended battery life. The Gigantus V2 Pro focuses on surface customisation, offering multiple friction options paired with different foam firmness levels. Both products are aimed at competitive gaming setups and are now available in India through official channels, with broader retail availability expected soon.
title: Razer Viper V4 Pro Wireless Gaming Mouse Launched Alongside Razer Gigantus V2 Pro Mouse Mat: Price, Features

description: The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special is a documentary show that explores the journey of Miley Cyrus as a popular Disney star.
title: The Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special Now on JioHotstar: Know Everything About The Show

description: The Vivo X300 Ultra and Vivo X300s are confirmed to launch in China soon as the latest additions to the X300 series, alongside the Vivo Pad 6 Pro. Ahead of their anticipated launch, the company has revealed the colourways of the upcoming phones and tablet. The Vivo X300 Ultra and X300s models are teased to be offered in similar green and silver colourways, while the Ultra model will also come in a black shade.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra, X300s and Vivo Pad 6 Pro Colour Options Revealed Ahead of China Launch

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 will be launched by the South Korean tech giant with a similar design to its predecessor, the leaked computer-aided design (CAD) renders suggest. The book-style foldable is shown to feature a similar triple rear camera unit, housed inside a vertical pill-shaped camera module. An LED flash also appears next to the deco. Moreover, the phone might continue to sport hole punch display cutouts on the cover and foldable displays. Moreover, the purported Galaxy Z Fold 8 could be marginally thinner than its predecessor, measuring 3.9mm when unfolded and 9mm in the folded state.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Design Spotted in Leaked Renders; Could Be Marginally Thinner Than Predecessor

description: Bitcoin traded near $71,000 on Wednesday, holding steady despite mixed ETF flows and macro pressure. Analysts highlighted support near $70,000 and resistance around $72,000, keeping the market range-bound. Ethereum showed relative strength, while altcoins posted selective gains. Experts advise cautious accumulation as macro factors continue to drive sentiment.
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum Trade in Narrow Range as Market Awaits Breakout Signal

description: A leak suggests iQOO may expand its Neo 11 lineup with two new models, possibly the Neo 11 Pro and Neo 11 Pro+. These devices are said to feature 6.83-inch 2K LTPS flat displays with high refresh rates, which could be rare in this segment. They may also include metal frames, 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensors, and silicon batteries exceeding 8,000mAh. The phones are expected to use Snapdragon 8 Elite and Dimensity 9500 chipsets, placing them in the upper midrange category.
title: iQOO Neo 11 Pro, Neo 11 Pro+ Tipped to Feature 2K Screen and 8,000mAh+ Battery

description: A romantic drama about two strangers navigating love and life together.
title: Couple Friendly Now on OTT: Where to Watch This Love Story Online?

description: Resort is a Tamil comedy-drama web series that is now available to stream only on JioHotstar. The series explores the workplace politics and ambitions behind a beach resort.
title: Resort Streaming Now on JioHotstar: All You Need to Know About This Tamil Web Series Online

description: Vivo T4 Pro launched last year with a 6,500mAh battery and the Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 chipset. Now, Vivo appears to be preparing the launch of its successor, the Vivo T5 Pro. Ahead of the official announcement, a tipster has shared the phone’s key specifications. The Vivo T5 Pro is expected to come with a 1.5K resolution display, a 9,020mAh battery with 90W fast charging support.
title: Vivo T5 Pro Tipped to Launch in India Soon; Said to Feature Bigger Battery Over Vivo T4 Pro

description: The Samsung Galaxy A37 5G and Galaxy A57 5G are soon going to launch in India as the latest entrants in the Samsung Galaxy A-series lineup. Before their launch, the prices for both handsets have been leaked. According to a tipster, the Samsung Galaxy A57 5G is going to be launched in two variants with a starting price tag of Rs. 56,999. On the other hand, three variants of the Galaxy A37 5G may be introduced.
title: Samsung Galaxy A37, Galaxy A57 5G Price in India Tipped Ahead of Launch

description: Apple released the iOS 26.4 update for iPhone on Tuesday. It is the long-anticipated fourth major iteration of the latest iPhone operating system, which the Cupertino-based tech giant first released in September. The update adds several new features, including Playlist Playground and full-screen backgrounds in Apple Music, support for AirPods Max 2, and eight new emojis. However, the iPhone update does not include the highly-awaited Apple Intelligence features, such as a smarter version of Siri.
title: iOS 26.4 Update for iPhone Rolls Out With AI-Generated Playlists in Apple Music, 8 New Emojis

description: OnePlus may be developing an Android-based handheld gaming console, according to leaks. The device is expected to take a touchscreen-first approach, focusing on multi-finger input, responsiveness, and performance optimisation for FPS titles like PUBG Mobile and Delta Force. It may feature flagship-level tuning and high refresh rate support. An unofficial render suggests a design with ergonomic grips, shoulder buttons, and minimal physical controls. While the concept reflects a shift toward new hardware categories, OnePlus has not confirmed any details so far.
title: OnePlus Could Be Working on Android Handheld Console With Focus on FPS Touch Controls

description: A Weibo tipster claims that Apple is facing difficulties advancing its under-display technology. The upcoming iPhone models are said to continue to feature smaller, more compact designs, but a truly full-screen display may be far from reality. Earlier rumours suggested that Apple would introduce the iPhone 20 with a full-screen experience, eliminating camera cutouts. Apple is expected to add an under-display Face ID system to the iPhone 18 Pro series.
title: No All-Screen iPhone 20? Why Apple’s 20th Anniversary Model May Miss Its Biggest Feature

description: Epic Games' Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Tim Sweeney announced in a blog post that the Fortnite developer is laying off more than 1,000 employees. The company executive said that the downturn in Fortnite engagement, which began in 2025, was one of the major reasons behind the decision, which will help the company stabilise its finances. However, he highlighted that the layoffs at Epic Games are not “related to AI”. Moreover, the company plans to reduce contracting and marketing expenses and close some open roles.
title: Epic Games Lays Off More Than 1,000 Employees, CEO Cites Downturn in Fortnite Engagement

description: Apple on Wednesday announced a new unified platform called Apple Business. It is aimed at helping companies manage devices, streamline operations, and expand their reach across Apple’s ecosystem. As per the Cupertino-based tech giant, the service brings together several existing enterprise tools under one umbrella, while also introducing new features for communication, device management, and customer engagement, including advertisements in Apple Maps.
title: What Is Apple Business: 5 Points to Understand the New Unified Platform

description: OpenAI, on Tuesday, announced plans to shut down the popular Sora app. The discontinuation impacts both the mobile app and the application programming interface (API). The San Francisco-based artificial intelligence (AI) giant did not share the reason behind sunsetting the platform, or when it plans to hit the kill switch.
title: OpenAI to Shut Down the Popular AI Video Sora App, Said to Let Go of Mega Disney Deal

description: Qualcomm may adopt a dual-chip strategy for its next flagship lineup, with Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro and standard variants. A recent leak points to two chips, SM8975 and SM8950, both built on TSMC’s 2nm process with a 2+3+3 CPU setup. The Pro variant may feature an Adreno 850 GPU, LPDDR6 support, and higher cache, while the standard version may use a slightly lower-end GPU and LPDDR5X. The Pro model could be limited to premium devices.
title: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro Leak Highlights Differences From Standard Model

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra was launched last month at the company's Galaxy Unpacked event. iFixit has released a teardown video of the new smartphone, giving us a glimpse at its internals and rating its repairability. The firm has given the phone five out of ten. Removing the rear panel, battery, and USB Type-C port appears to be relatively straightforward, but the video notes that it is difficult to remove the display and selfie shooter.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Teardown Video Reveals Repairability Score; Falls Behind the iPhone 17 Pro

description: Apple is said to be preparing a broader push into artificial intelligence (AI), and among the initiatives is a major overhaul of its voice assistant Siri. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant is testing a standalone Siri app that includes deeper integration with system features. While the AI assistant will continue to be activated by the same triggers, a redesigned interface could be introduced to replace the existing glowing edges effect.
title: Apple Preparing Major Siri Overhaul With Standalone App, New Interface, Contextual AI Features: Report

description: Meta and Arm announced a partnership on Tuesday to jointly develop a new class of CPUs that support heavy artificial intelligence (AI) workloads. These CPUs will be designed to support data centres and large-scale AI deployments, and are not expected to be available to the end consumer. The two companies also unveiled the Arm AGI CPU, the first chipset designed for Meta’s data centres.
title: Meta Partners With Arm to Build Chipsets for AI Workloads, Unveils Arm AGI CPU

description: Vivo Y21 5G and Vivo Y11 5G have been launched in India, the Chinese smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The two new handsets are scheduled to go on sale in the country via the Vivo India online store. The Vivo Y21 5G is offered in 4GB+128GB, 6GB+128GB, and 8GB+128GB RAM and storage configurations. On the other hand, the Vivo Y11 5G will go on sale in the country in 4GB+64GB and 4GB+128GB options. Both handsets are equipped with 6,500mAh batteries, coupled with the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipsets.
title: Vivo Y21 5G and Vivo Y11 5G Launched in India With 6,500mAh Batteries, Dimensity 6300 SoC: Price, Features

description: Realme P4 Lite 5G is now available for purchase in India. The new Realme P series smartphone was launched last week with a MediaTek Dimensity 6300 5G chipset and a 6.8-inch display. It has a starting price tag of Rs. 12,999. It features a 7,000mAh battery with 15W wired charging support. It has a 13-megapixel rear camera unit. You can buy this model from Flipkart, the Realme India website, and offline retail stores.
title: Realme P4 Lite 5G Goes on Sale in India for the First Time: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers
